title: Greening to shield: The impacts of extreme rainfall on economic activity in Latin American cities

idea.research_question: How does extreme rainfall alter urban economic activity, and does greener land cover moderate the disruption?
idea.hypothesis: Rainfall extremes reduce activity, while greener urban land cover attenuates the reduction through improved infiltration and flood buffering.
idea.mechanism: City-month panel, fixed effects, rainfall-extreme indicators, interaction terms and counterfactual avoided-loss estimation
idea.expected_contribution: Transfers satellite activity measurement into flood-economics and green-infrastructure evaluation.
idea.falsification_condition: Reject if any required role is omitted, background-only, or not operationally used in the same research instance.

anchor_context.extraction_basis: Full-text seed evidence; empirical results are excluded from the task prompt.
